from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import json,hashlib,requests,re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/"reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_source_and_prior_use_probe_v1"
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
plan=[
 {"url":"https://tushare.pro/document/2?doc_id=256","method":"GET","role":"提供方repo_daily字段/单位及DR007.IB的20200804独立示例","file":"提供方_repo_daily_doc256.html"},
 {"url":"https://www.chinamoney.com.cn/ags/ms/cm-u-dlrp/PrDlyBltn","method":"POST","role":"按提供方唯一文档样例日20200804核官方同品种数量；不挑日期，不下载完整历史",
  "form":{"lang":"en","indexType":"markInterBankVOList","searchDate":"2020-08-04","publishedTime":"2200"},"file":"官方日报_固定20200804响应.json"}]
p=OUT/"直接来源请求计划_01.json";assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps({"registered_at":now(),"unique_urls":2,"plan":plan,"known_local_daily_20260928_reused_not_requested":True,"no_credentials":True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
def fetch(spec):
 rec={k:v for k,v in spec.items() if k!="file"};rec.update({"started_at":now(),"retry":False})
 try:
  kw={"timeout":(10,25),"allow_redirects":True,"headers":{"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Accept":"application/json,text/html,*/*"}}
  resp=requests.get(spec["url"],**kw) if spec["method"]=="GET" else requests.post(spec["url"],data=spec["form"],**kw)
  raw=resp.content;assert len(raw)<=8388608
  p=OUT/spec["file"];assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes(raw)
  rec.update({"status":resp.status_code,"final_url":resp.url,"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
   "raw_path":p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),"raw_saved":True,
   "headers":{k:v for k,v in resp.headers.items() if k.lower() in {"date","content-type","last-modified","content-length","etag"}}})
  if spec["method"]=="GET" and resp.status_code==200:
   soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,"html.parser");text=soup.get_text(" ",strip=True)
   (OUT/"提供方字段说明_全文.txt").write_text(text,encoding="utf-8")
   pos=text.find("接口：repo_daily")
   print(json.dumps({"提供方正文":text[pos:pos+4200] if pos>=0 else text[-4200:]},ensure_ascii=False))
  elif resp.status_code==200:
   try:
    d=resp.json(); rec["response_top_level_keys"]=list(d);rec["response_data"]=d.get("data")
    rows=d.get("records") or []; rec["record_count"]=len(rows)
    rec["DR007_rows"]=[v for v in rows if str(v.get("instrmntCd"))=="DR007"]
    print(json.dumps({"官方固定样例":rec["response_data"],"DR007":rec["DR007_rows"],"行数":len(rows)},ensure_ascii=False))
   except (ValueError,AttributeError) as e:rec["parse_error"]=type(e).__name__
 except Exception as e:
  rec.update({"error_type":type(e).__name__,"error":"请求或解析失败；无重试","raw_saved":rec.get("raw_saved",False)})
 rec["completed_at"]=now();return rec
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as ex:ledger=list(ex.map(fetch,plan))
assert sum(r.get("bytes",0) for r in ledger)<=8388608
p=OUT/"request_ledger.json";assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"来源请求":len(ledger),"HTTP状态":[r.get("status") for r in ledger],"字节":sum(r.get("bytes",0) for r in ledger),"带凭据API":0},ensure_ascii=False))
